scope.matching: Exact class-token boundary matching; ignored main app.css itself, searched other CSS plus source and relevant package JS/TS/HTML/JSON. Dynamic className, classList, attribute and keyframe construction reviewed separately.

retentionBoundary: Selectors containing any literal class token found in src/vendor/rendering dependencies remain in place, including mixed comma lists.
All :is/:where/:not/:has rules are held for semantic review even when their class tokens are absent.
Markdown, KaTeX, Mermaid and other generated-content styles remain unless their producer/output path is demonstrably absent; no deletion candidate relies on those generated classes.
Responsive, reduced-motion and color-scheme rules are retained unless their entire selector rule independently meets removal criteria.
Generic button/text-control selectors remain held; Button uses ui-button plus explicit caller class and data-variant, with no variant-derived class mapping.
All generated media, artifact, Markdown, KaTeX and Mermaid style families are held despite lexical gaps.
Any comma-list rule with one emitted branch remains whole; every :is/:where/:not/:has rule remains whole.

Final removal list has 205 rule nodes: 207 exact-token candidates gained 9 compound rules with only unproduced scenario/provider wrapper classes, while 8 fully unreferenced complex selectors, 1 text-control rule, and 2 generic primary/secondary button rules remain held. The broader 34-rule complex review list includes 26 mixed-context rules held regardless of lexical status.
